question: Estimate the reach of a print ad in Times of India (full-page colour, all India editions).
idealClarificationQuestions: Single-day full-page colour TOI ad across all editions? Yes.
Reach = unique readers who see the ad? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Circulation × readers per copy × ad-noticing rate.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: TOI total daily circulation (all editions): ~26-28 lakh.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Total readership (eyeballs on the paper): ~10-11 crore opportunities.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Estimated unique readers exposed: 10.5 crore × 0.72 = ~7.5 crore.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Pure reach number: ~7.5 crore unique readers see the page; ~1.9 crore actively process/recall.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Readers per copy (RPC, Indian newspaper average)
benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~4 (newspaper read by multiple family members, office subscribers).

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Of these, recall the ad (after 1 day)

benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~7.5 crore unique readers see the page; ~1.9 crore actively process/recall.

calculationFlow: TOI total daily circulation (all editions): ~26-28 lakh.
Total readership (eyeballs on the paper): ~10-11 crore opportunities.
Estimated unique readers exposed: 10.5 crore × 0.72 = ~7.5 crore.
Of these, recall the ad (after 1 day): ~25% = ~1.9 crore.
Pure reach number: ~7.5 crore unique readers see the page; ~1.9 crore actively process/recall.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: Pure reach number: ~7.5 crore unique readers see the page; ~1.9 crore actively process/recall.
